notes: Every control: both sticks first, then a hands-off check, then the rest in layout order (triggers, every button including the D-pad, the paddles, the SAX buttons, G1-G5, Profile and Start). About three minutes. Run it on the Engine path first and on Driver LIVE after that, then compare the two reports. The sticks come before the hands-off check because the pad posts nothing while idle and does not answer GetReport: its state is known only after it has moved once, and a stick step ends at centre.

steps.detail: Push it to the rim and go all the way round, slowly, once or twice, then release it. Leave the right stick alone.
steps.title: Roll the LEFT stick in one or two slow circles, then let go

steps.title: Roll the RIGHT stick in one or two slow circles, then let go

steps.detail: Put the controller down and let go of every stick, trigger and button. The pad has to stay completely still.
